title: Zephyr: Check-In / Roll Call implementation
close_reason: Implemented Check-In / Roll Call per spec 12 18.6 in C. (1) checkin.c: pure C11 CBOR codec + service (check-in 18.6.1, roll-call 18.6.2/18.6.3, scheduled config 18.6.4; prune-oldest-by-ts, 5.03-at-capacity, timeout 1..604800, far-future reject, int-id coercion, inclusive coord bounds, full-notation addr validation) with header lichen/checkin.h; caller-provisioned storage, no globals, thread-unsafe per repo convention. (2) checkin_resource.c + lichen/checkin_resource.h: /checkin GET+POST, /rollcall GET+POST, /config/checkin PUT CoAP handlers over lichen_coap_server, mutex-serialized instance, CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN + CONFIG_LICHEN_CHECKIN_RESOURCE + capacity knobs in coap/Kconfig, wired in coap/CMakeLists.txt. (3) Verification, both on this Mac: host CMake suite lichen/tests/checkin_rollcall consuming all 25 wire vectors from test/vectors/checkin_rollcall.json via generated header with byte-exact decode->encode re-encode, oracle error-string mapping, service policy tests at oracle capacity 256 — 14/14 tests, ctest 100%, Apple clang -Werror -Wconversion + ASan/UBSan; twister qemu_x86/atom ztest lichen/tests/checkin_resource exercising handlers with stubbed respond — 5/5 test cases, 1/1 configurations passed, no warnings. Commit f4b19ff6c6. Also committed the never-committed vectors deliverable checkin_rollcall.json (closed bead 10.19.4) since gen_vectors.py needs it at configure time; filed project-LICHEN-worker6-co35 for stale cbor_length fields in that file.
